articles.title: Tyson Foods Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results

articles.summary: Tyson Foods announced today that Jeff Schomburger has been named President and Chief Executive Officer, effective October 4, 2026. Following a transition period beginning in July, Schomburger will succeed Donnie King, who has had an incredible 43-year career with the company.
articles.title: Tyson Foods Announces Jeff Schomburger to Succeed Donnie King as President and CEO
